verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, PC 34076, 1976).

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
Includes poetry and credit insert with band logo, plain inner sleeve.

First cat. no. CBS 81221 on sleeve
Second cat. no. S 81221 on labels

Recorded at Caribou Ranch, Colorado - February 1976.
Remixed at Trident Studios in England.

Produced in coordination with Forever Unlimited Productions. 

Published by Litha Music Co. (MCPS), except:
A2 by Mchoma Music
B1 by DiMeola Music
B2 by Clarkee Music

Shorepak by Shorewood Packaging Co. Ltd., England

On insert:
P 1362
Thank you Bob Moog for rushing the Polymoog to Chick.
Composition ″The Romantic Warrior″ is dedicated to L. Ron Hubbard.

On inner sleeve:
PATENT Nos. 1,125,555   MADE IN GREAT BRITAIN.

Made in England
